value.layerInfo: Bends Cavalry Geo imagery onto the globe and Equal Earth. Cavalry Geo adds and connects it for you when you build imagery.

camProjection: Connected from the map camera: 0 Web Mercator, 1 Equal Earth, 2 globe.
viewScale: Set every frame by Cavalry Geo: how much the imagery source is shrunk.
viewOffset: Set every frame by Cavalry Geo: the centre of the imagery source's visible area.
